steps.content: -The Origins of the Underground The origins of the Underground are unclear and practically untraceable. As early as the initial years of the Nightfall era, references to the Underground had already begun appearing amid a mixture of folk legends, religious beliefs, scams, and even pyramid schemes. However, these accounts were often exaggerated and distorted. Combined with the secretive, nebulous nature of early Mania-related phenomena and special powers, it is nearly impossible to determine what, if any, of these accounts were genuine.

The conflicts following Euphoria and the Ash Campaign have taught you just how vigilant and cunning the Sillage Society can be. At the slightest whiff of trouble, they'll vanish without a trace, taking all evidence with them. You'll need to tread carefully to avoid alerting them.

So this time, you carefully map out your investigative approach. Publicly, you remain cooperative with the Ring Research Institute and stay friendly toward Isomer. But behind her back, you quietly identify all the collaborative projects involving her and work out her network of investors.

So far, the investigation has only confirmed one thing: The Director is exceptionally meticulous. Her proposals, press conferences, and progress reports have all been flawless, exposing no weaknesses you can exploit.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: If something is troubling you, Chief, perhaps you should look at this. Terminal 0490 has received new intel. Would you like me to sync it to your device?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: New intel? Nice!

Ash Campaign Public Casualty Reports BR-005 War Zone Post-Battle Contamination Pathway Simulation (FAC Internal) Nirvana Hypercube Production Capacity Allocation Records - N.F. 113 Q1 Eastside District 3 Annual Residential Energy Consumption Report - N.F. 114 Syndicate North District Annual Residential Energy Consumption Report - N.F. 114 Ring Research Institute Project Team Structure Overview United University Q3 Procurement List (Filed with Administration) Hypercube-Derived Waste Materials in Construction: Feasibility Study, Vol. 2 Eastside Water System Mania Index Anomalies (N.F. 111–114) Ring Research Institute Laboratory Energy Monitoring Upgrade Proposal Comparative Survey of Resident Health Conditions Across Districts of DisCity - N.F. 114 (Public Edition) Ring Research Institute Jurisdictional Expansion Project Plan (Revised Draft) Annual Water and Electricity Consumption Statistical Report of Ring Research Institute and Affiliated Monitoring Stations - N.F. 114

You'd hoped the intellect would keep providing useful information. Instead, what you receive is a thick stack of incomprehensible documents. While not completely useless, they are clearly irrelevant to the key evidence you're after.

steps.speaker: Option
options: What's the point of all this data?
Why did Celine send me all these?
Did you send the wrong files, Schorl?

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: Oh? I believe the nature of the data is clearly reflected in their titles, namely...

The idiot machine proceeds to read out every single title to you. Whether it's being deliberately obtuse or it really is this dumb is anyone's guess. Its intelligence seems to fluctuate wildly. You have no choice but to push Schorl aside before it starts reading the actual file contents aloud.
Jump

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: The Professor is currently unavailable. You may need to wait before you can get your answer.
For a moment, you almost wonder if this is simply another one of her usual jokes.
Jump
It beeps and buzzes while spinning and bouncing around erratically. You're not sure what it's trying to say. Eventually, you push it aside.
end
Just then, another voice speaks up beside you.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Hold on.

Her eyes lock onto the comms device in your hands. Without a word, she reaches over and takes it, fingers flying across the screen, swiping, tapping, zooming in and out. By the time the flashing text and pixels are starting to make you dizzy, Linda finally pinpoints something.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Something seems off.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Project No. 3427 applied for FAC funding, claiming to research ways to improve anti-Mania barrier efficiency. But according to the available casualty reports, most of the leading experts in that field were affected by the war. In fact, several are still on medical leave now. With the current team, there's no way they could maintain the research progress described in their reports.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: And here...

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: A laboratory expansion for urban Mania monitoring. The cash flows, procurement records, and tax declarations all look reasonable on paper, but while it claims the on-site staff doubled, the utility consumption barely increased over the last two years. So where did the expansion go?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Linda, you...
The history scholar looks at you.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Chief, we're not detectives, accountants, or investigators. We don't have the means to gather all the relevant evidence. But we can still spot contradictions by cross-checking. Now that we've found these discrepancies, let's leave the rest to the professionals.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: As my professor likes to say...

steps.speaker: Celine & Linda
steps.content: No one can conceal the truth. If it was ever here, it left traces behind. And truths have a way of corroborating one another. That is our work.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Ah, please excuse me! I was probably just misquoting the Professor's words... All that wild speculation must have made things more complicated for you. I should just stick to being a good camera, um, I mean, a good archivist.
And just like that, she's that flustered, inexperienced student again.

steps.speaker: Option
options: No, you've been a huge help.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Celine didn't send you just to return a favor. She knows how valuable you are.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thank you, Linda. I'm going to need your help with the cross-checking work going forward, if you don't mind.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Me?
She looks somewhat surprised, then a little embarrassed. Finally, she lowers her head slightly and speaks quietly.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: I'm the one who should say thank you. I'm glad I could help...
